_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% base rate of ±2+ point moves makes HOLD the statistically honest call in this coil, and neither brain has identified a confirmed breaker — the analyst's own 17.1% direction accuracy reinforces that forcing a directional guess here is low-probability.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the narrative implies a bottoming recovery (UP) while the analyst explicitly calls HOLD; I side with the analyst's HOLD based on the base rate and lack of a confirmed breaker.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed drops below 24 with VIX spiking above 25 and funding flipping negative → confirms Panic leg down
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows recover above 30 with stablecoin growth breaking above 55 and BTC momentum pushing 60+ → invalidates the coil, forcing a Disbelief/Hope transition up
